text:
Amanda (AE): quick sync — Dan's team wants to expand the POC scope to include embeddings + reranking on top of the chat generation. originally just evaling response quality for prompts. any blockers?
Ryan (Solutions): noted. main concerns: extra infra for embeddings pipeline, egress for vector db, and throughput impact. also need new eval prompts for rerank.
Dan (Customer): correct — use case is conversational search + answer synthesis. we need recall@10 for retrieval + final response quality. can you include an offline eval set?
Priya (PM): success criteria proposal: 1) p95 latency for chat path <= 350ms, 2) rerank recall@10 >= 0.85 on our eval set, 3) end-to-end cost delta < 2x baseline. timeline impact?
Amanda (AE): timeline ask from customer: want demo week of 5/18. today is tight. if we add embeddings, we may need +2 weeks unless we reuse hosted vector db and precompute. thoughts @ryan?
Ryan (Solutions): reuse hosted vector DB -> fastest but customer wants data-in-region and some control. options: a) hosted vector DB + VPC peering (fast to demo, slightly higher cost) b) run vector store in their VPC (longer setup, networking + infra ops). For model: propose running quantized rerank model (int8) to keep GPU footprints small. quality tradeoff small but measurable.
Jess (Security): from questionnaire side: need answers for DATA_RESIDENCY, KMS integration, and audit logs for embeddings storage. also ask whether embeddings are encrypted at rest by default. Dan, can you confirm retention policy?
Dan (Customer): retention: embeddings must be retained for 90 days, then purge. keys are customer-managed KMS. we can't accept embeddings leaving our VPC for production, demo ok though.
Amanda (AE): pricing question from legal: if we add embeddings & rerank, how should we adjust POC pricing? we currently quoted hosted inference only.
Ryan (Solutions): pragmatic POC pricing: add a line item for vector storage + monthly bandwidth estimate, and a one-time setup for VPC peering if needed. for demo we can offer a discounted setup fee. rough numbers: +$1k/mo for vector storage (small scale) + $1.5k one-time peering/setup.
Priya (PM): also define evaluation prompts now. Dan please provide 100 seed queries and a labeled set of expected passages. we'll run automated rerank eval and manual quality review.
Dan (Customer): I can share the seed queries by EOD. also flag: some queries include PII — we need redaction in logs.
Jess (Security): we can enable structured redaction in logging and store a redacted copy for debug. will need ACLs on logs and proof of deletion at 90d.
Amanda (AE): can we keep demo on 5/18 by scoping MVP: hosted vector DB + precomputed embeddings for a small subset (50 queries) + toggled rerank? If yes, Dan, will that satisfy the demo ask?
Dan (Customer): yes for demo as long as we show representative quality and can commit to the 90d retention for production.
Ryan (Solutions): tech checklist for MVP demo: 1) pipeline to compute embeddings (we'll run offline), 2) simple reranker endpoint (int8 model), 3) routing policy that falls back to chat-only if rerank latency spikes, 4) small vector store instance in hosted region. I'll sketch infra runbook.
poc-bot: POC ticket created: RDW-2345. Linked drive: https://redwood.box.com/s/poC-rdwdemo (permissions: sales + solutions + customer).
deploy-bot: capacity request logged: reserved small-gpu pool for 3 days starting 2026-05-16. Request ID: CAP-4521.
Priya (PM): follow-ups: Ryan to confirm quality delta for int8 reranker by EOD tomorrow. Jess to send required questionnaire snippets for retention/KMS. Amanda to update SOW/pricing and confirm with Dan.
Amanda (AE): thanks — I'll update the SOW draft and ping legal. tagging @Dan once SOW updated. :thumbsup:
Dan (Customer): thanks all, looking forward.
Ryan (Solutions): quick note on tradeoffs: if recall target isn't met with int8, we can switch rerank to float16 on-demand (cost up) or do hybrid rerank (candidate pruning then heavy rerank for top-k). will outline in runbook.
Jess (Security): final: for production we need ATO checklist items; for demo we can operate under a scoped exception with documented controls.
Amanda (AE): perfect — closing thread for now, will post SOW link in this thread when ready.
